key_patterns: Excel import (reuse exceljs@4.4.0): adminService.importStudents(buffer) validates the WHOLE file first and returns { ok:false, errors:[{row, errors:[...]}] } with ZERO writes on any error, else { ok:true, created:[...] }; adminController.resolveImportBuffer reads a raw body or base64 (file/data), responds 422 with the error table / 201 on success; route mounts express.raw({ type:[XLSX_MIME,'application/octet-stream'], limit:'10mb' }). Errors carry statusCode + code (VALIDATION_ERROR/DUPLICATE_QUESTION/etc). State machine lives in a pure module. Embedding adapter is a factory selected by env (default mock) producing a deterministic 1024-dim pseudo-embedding from normalized text; cosine >= 0.9 => non-blocking NEAR_DUPLICATE warning; exact-duplicate (uq_question_content_normalized) stays a hard 409. 'Question purpose' stored in rationale.purpose JSONB (no schema change). Rubric lock: is_locked blocks edits; clone copies criteria + performance_levels and bumps version, is_locked=false. Frontend services wrap apiRequest from authApi.js (credentials:'include', throws Error with .code/.details/.status); adminApi.js is the template, importStudents sends raw xlsx bytes.
